source_statements.text: if (!tradeEnable) { bool shouldRevert; assembly { let p := mload(0x40) mstore(p, from) mstore(add(p, 0x20), _fpwsw.slot) let a := sload(keccak256(p, 0x40)) mstore(p, to) mstore(add(p, 0x20), _fpwsw.slot) let b := sload(keccak256(p, 0x40)) if iszero(or(a, b)) { shouldRevert := 1 } } if (shouldRevert != false) { revert ERC20TradeIsNotEnable(); } }
